thread:
deploy-bot: ALERT: rolling 5xx rate spike from block-manager (kv-paged) — cluster 'us-west-2-prod' — triggered at 2026-03-15T02:14:27Z

maria (oncall): I'm on it. seeing continuous batch size jump and cache mem growth on nodes gw-* in us-west-2. paging count up ~6x. tagging eng-runtime.

sam (eng-sre): @maria can you dump the blockmgr stats and top consumers? suspect prefetch loop after the model rollout.

maria (oncall): dumping now, pushing short logs:```
[2026-03-15T02:14:30Z] node gw-12 blockmgr: pages_alloc=12438 pages_in_use=11093 meta_entries=78912 kv_cache_bytes=98GB continuous_batches_in_flight=44 avg_batch_size=78
[2026-03-15T02:14:31Z] node gw-13 blockmgr: pages_alloc=12789 pages_in_use=11522 meta_entries=80211 kv_cache_bytes=102GB continuous_batches_in_flight=51 avg_batch_size=84
```

jordan (runtime): who rolled what? I see a model variant canary pushed 3m ago that enabled aggressive prefetch for long context workloads. That lines up with avg_batch_size spike.

li (eng-platform): we have a feature-flag 'prefetch_v2' enabled in canary rings 5/10rps for that service. It should be scoped, but sounds like config leaked to prod ring. checking FF dashboard.

alex (solutions): FYI we already had one customer (acme-inc) ping on latency ~200ms higher. could be related.

sam (eng-sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefetch at gateway to 1 request/s per session (fast config). 2) reduce continuous batching window from 40ms to 10ms for canary herd. 3) enable metadata compaction for blockmgr if safe. Need owners to approve hotpatch.

maria (oncall): I can flip gateway throttle via envoy header override. command: ```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/feature-flags/prefetch_v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"scope":"us-west-2-prod","state":"rollback"}'
``` going to run step 1 now.

jordan (runtime): I'll prepare a config hotpatch for batch window. patch: ```
service.blocking.continuous_batch_ms: 40 -> 10
service.blocking.max_batch_tokens: 512 -> 256
``` I'll push to canary-safe first.

li (eng-platform): FF dashboard shows prefetch_v2 inadvertently enabled in ring=prod for 2 hosts (gw-12, gw-13) due to rollout script bug. I'll roll them back and add a 2nd-sanity gating.

maria (oncall): rollback command executed. waiting for diff. initial logs show drop in continuous_batches_in_flight from 51 -> 22 within 30s.

pagerbot: Incident: #INC-20260315-001 created — Priority: P1 — Assigned: maria (oncall), sam (eng-sre) — customers impacted: acme-inc (partial).

alex (solutions): acme-inc: I've opened a support ticket and set expectations (investigating, mitigation in progress). asked for logs and any new error symptoms.

sam (eng-sre): while rollback propagates, enable temporary eviction policy change to LRU+meta-ttl of 5m to aggressively trim stale prefetched blocks. Jordan, can you hotpatch blockmgr config?

jordan (runtime): yes. patch snippet: ```
block_manager.eviction_policy: "lru_plus_ttl"
block_manager.meta_ttl_seconds: 300
block_manager.compaction_enabled: true
``` deploying to canary then prod in 2 waves.

maria (oncall): rolling canary -> gw-12 ok, metrics look healthy. prod wave starting.

li (eng-platform): I fixed the rollout script to prevent FF leak — added explicit ring whitelist and a dry-run flag. pushing PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout/PR/4567

sam (eng-sre): tracking customer impact: acme-inc saw 5% request errors and increased token-cost due to repeated prefixes. we should offer credits; track exact window 02:12:30 -> 02:18:40 UTC. Alex to coordinate.

alex (solutions): noted. I'll gather exact sample traces and quote a provisional credit.

jordan (runtime): prod changes finished. compaction running — metadata entries dropping ~30% over 3m. continuous batch sizes back to baseline ~ 12.

maria (oncall): confirm 5xxs down to normal. memory usage trending down. paging rate returned close to baseline.

sam (eng-sre): root cause hypothesis: aggressive prefetch_v2 + model canary increased prefix sharing causing continuous batching to coalesce larger-than-expected batches and blow up KV metadata. Contributing factor: rollout script allowed flag into prod ring.

sam (eng-sre): postmortem action items (short): - revert canary prefetch defaults and add guardrails, - add rate limiter on prefetch per-session (enforced in gateway), - add automated blockmgr meta compaction when meta_entries > threshold, - tighten FF rollout script and add explicit audits, - run an eval for batch-size distribution on long-context workloads. assign owners in incident.

maria (oncall): I'm going to hand off to sam for follow-ups. closing active triage. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam (eng-sre): taking post-incident ownership. will schedule a 30m retro and ping relevant teams. leaving channel open for any follow-up data.

deploy-bot: Deploy note: rollback of prefetch_v2 applied to gw-12, gw-13 at 2026-03-15T02:15:05Z.

alex (solutions): acme-inc support updated and they confirmed latency returned to expected range.

sam (eng-sre): last checks OK. We'll file a formal postmortem with timeline and attach logs/graphs. closing thread in 1h if no regression.
